interpretation: Illustrative engineering sensitivity scenarios, not process corners, confidence intervals, or guaranteed bounds. Clock coefficient includes register internal clock energy, clock input charging and a clock distribution allowance. Data activity is a coarse proxy using measured register rising transitions, not gate-level power annotation.
excluded_from_logic_power: instruction and data memory macro power
reference_warning: GF180MCU is a different foundry and cell family from TSMC 180 nm. One reference flip-flop informs only the order of magnitude; the DUT has not been mapped to this cell or library.
